summary: Chargebee offers a robust, flexible subscription management and billing platform that supports global expansion, multiple currencies, and over 30 payment gateways. It streamlines financial operations and enhances customer experiences, enabling businesses to efficiently manage customer churn, revenue recognition, and pricing experiments.

Plum offers comprehensive insurance and health benefits for businesses, ensuring their team stays healthy and protected against various risks. With over 4000 companies trusting Plum, they provide a suite of benefits backed by technology and expert support, including Directors & Officers Insurance, Commercial General Liability Insurance, Asset Protection Insurance, Errors and Omissions/Professional Indemnity, Cyber Liability Insurance, and Employee Dishonesty Insurance.

RevenueHero is a scheduling tool designed for B2B marketers, sales, and operations teams, aiming to improve the buying experience and increase results. It automates the qualification and scheduling of meetings, enabling prospects to book meetings directly on your website, and ensuring fair distribution of meetings among the sales team.
